scope: Nine existing physical devices; one device-name query per device through an explicitly bound local IPv4 source
method: Resolve the explicitly selected interface through AppSettings
Resolve each endpoint and ARC port from fresh local-daemon inventory and require baseline MAC identity agreement
Create an installed CoreClient with that source address, one attempt, and a 750 ms timeout
Inspect only the verification process's UDP sockets with lsof and require the selected source address
Query the device name once, require agreement with inventory, and close the client
excluded_evidence: Proprietary firmware or application executable inspection
transformation: Aggregate the digest-bound local results by advertised ARC revision; omit endpoint addresses, MAC identities, returned device names, and ephemeral source ports
limitations: One selected interface on one Mac; no alternate-interface or other-OS experiment
No physical lock/unlock verification; the separate lock socket's source inheritance is covered by offline native tests
No claim about audio routing, media delivery, or unsupported wire revisions
